event_chain.summary: Theft of ID documents from vandalized government vehicles
Agent identity information exposed and posted online

summary: During unrest in Minneapolis in January 2026 involving anti-ICE demonstrators after a shooting, two federal government vehicles were vandalized and identification documents belonging to FBI agents and employees were stolen. Information from the documents was posted online and, per a criminal complaint, as many as 15 FBI agents and employees were subsequently harassed and threatened.
